turns.content: In this study, we introduce an effective analytical approach known as Gene Set Enrichment Analysis (GSEA) that facilitates the interpretation of gene expression data. Rather than examining individual genes, GSEA places emphasis on gene sets, which refer to groups of genes that display common biological function, regulation, or chromosomal location, thereby leveraging the collective power of these sets.
